title: Kimi's New AI Slide Generator Beats PowerPoint — Here's How It Works
description:
Kimi just launched Agentic Slides — a presentation tool that 
combines K2 Thinking with Google's Nano Banana Pro for 
image generation.

It offers two modes 👇

✅ Adaptive Mode — free, McKinsey-style slides with professional 
charts. Best for academic and professional use. Fully editable — 
even redraw pie or bar charts by changing the numbers.
✅ Visual Mode — Nano Banana Pro powered, designer-level 
aesthetics for creative decks. Requires the paid tier for full access.

Adaptive mode pulls from Yahoo Finance, IMF, World Bank, 
Google Scholar and arXiv — so information stays traceable and sourced.

Export as PPT, Google Slides or PNG in either mode.

Just open Slides in the sidebar to get started.

----------------------------------------
